title: A sharp minimum for cube-apex bodies in every dimension
summary: We determine the minimum volume product of centrally symmetric polytopes obtained by adding facet apices to a cube while fixing their total outward height. Heights and tangential coordinates vary subject to a product condition on the polar-cap denominators. In every dimension at least two, the minimum has an explicit formula, attained by concentrating the height at one opposite pair of corner apices.
